title: Rank Transform of an Array
summary: Given an array of integers, substitute each element with its rank, where rank is the position of the element when the array is sorted in non-decreasing order, with ties receiving the same rank.
statement: Given an array of integers, substitute each element with its rank, where rank is the position of the element when the array is sorted in non-decreasing order, with ties receiving the same rank.
constraints: Rank starts at one; equal values share rank.
Ranks increase only between distinct values.
reference_solution:
def array_rank_transform(arr):
 rank={value:i+1 for i,value in enumerate(sorted(set(arr)))};return [rank[value] for value in arr]
hints: Map each distinct value to its one-based index in that ordering.
Replace each original value through the map.
The map preserves equality and strict value order while producing consecutive ranks.
editorial: The map preserves equality and strict value order while producing consecutive ranks.

tests.explanation: Sorted distinct values 10,20,30,40 map to ranks 1,2,3,4.
All equal values receive rank one.
